prompt:
This run is a frozen NextItNet / Movies_and_TV adaptation, seed 2024.
The task-specific contract overrides generic Kaggle pipeline instructions below.
Optimize validation HR@10 (higher is better) using ONLY a causal dilated-convolution
NextItNet. Source consists of exactly import math, import torch, import torch.nn as nn;
eight numeric constants MAXLEN,HIDDEN_UNITS,NUM_BLOCKS,KERNEL_SIZE,DROPOUT_RATE,LR,
WEIGHT_DECAY,BATCH_SIZE; and classes NextItNetBlock and NextItNetModel, methods only.
Preserve constructor, forward, encode_sequence and score_candidates interfaces.
The host owns preprocessing, splits, BPR loss, Adam, clipping, seed, epochs, negative
sampling, all training and all evaluation. Model code must not import extra modules,
access files/network, print, run training, implement evaluation, or generate CSV files.
For this task 'submission' means the host checkpoint and candidate scores. Generic
instructions to implement pipelines, install dependencies, print scores or save CSVs
are fulfilled by the frozen host; do not add such operations to model code.
Planner modules data_preparation/training/evaluation are frozen host components;
select only model-related components or hyperparameters. Fusion means merging
architectural insights into ONE NextItNet, not prediction ensembling. No test metric
is available during search. There are exactly 44 candidate slots, including debug
and fusion attempts. Do not inspect the filesystem, use tools, or edit files. Return
the requested response format, including markdown code or SEARCH/REPLACE when asked.

UPSTREAM REQUEST:
Transport acceptance only: choose model_design and propose changing residual branch scaling. Return reason, module=[model_design], plan={model_design: a concrete description}.

reason.description: The reason why you chose these components to modify. Based on the current status and execution results: 1) why these components are the most promising ones to focus on, 2) why these components are the right places to apply your modifications. Should be 1-4 sentences including root cause analysis.

module.description: An array of 1-3 module names to modify. Each element MUST be one of: data_processing_and_feature_engineering, model_design, training_evaluation. Choose 1-3 modules based on actual analysis, not from examples.

plan.title: Module Modification Plans
plan.description: A JSON object where keys are module names (must match exactly with names in the 'module' array) and values are detailed modification plan strings. CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: For EVERY module name listed in the 'module' array, you MUST create a corresponding key-value pair in this 'plan' object. The number of keys in 'plan' MUST equal the number of elements in 'module'. Each value must be a non-empty string containing the modification plan.

additionalProperties.title: Modification Plan
additionalProperties.description: A detailed modification plan (2-5 sentences) as a string. Must include: 1) WHAT to change (specific technical modification with category), 2) WHY this change (root cause analysis, why THIS TASK needs it), 3) HOW to implement (specific implementation approach), 4) Interface constraints (variable names, function signatures to preserve). Maintain existing variable names to ensure compatibility with other components. This string must not be empty.
